<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1267
Claimant:
Joshua Aguirre
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2023-10-01
Claim opened after a low-speed head-on collision reported by the insured's driver, who is named on the policy. The
claimant has retained counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
2023-10-27
Police report obtained. The responding officer recorded the claimant as present in the vehicle at the scene, and the
report describes the impact as head-on at low speed.
2023-11-30
Scene photographs and two independent witness statements were collected. Both witnesses describe the collision in
the same sequence as the other driver's account.
2023-12-22
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the accident happened as described and had no disagreement about the
order of events.
2024-01-13
Inspected the vehicle. The front-end damage pattern lines up with the reported impact, and the repair estmiate
reflects that same area and force.
2024-02-23
Ran a prior-damage check on the vehicle and reviewed the file history. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on record,
and nothing indicates the damage predates the start of coverage.
2024-02-29
Attorney submitted the claimant's initial injury notice citing shoulder pain. The reported injury is consistent in type and
severity with the force of a collision of this kind.
2024-04-07
Requested prior medical records. No earlier injury to the same shoulder area is known from the records available so
far.
2024-04-10
Claimant gave a recorded statement through counsel. The account of the accident matches what was described in
the first report.
2024-04-21
Follow-up call with the claimant. The account given was the same as in every prior conversation, with no changes to
the sequence or the details.
2024-04-23
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of shoulder injury. Treating provider notes are
being requested to document the reason for the extended course.
2024-04-27
Reviewed the file. Coverage is confirmed for the named driver, the vehicle damage matches the described impact,
and the claim will move to evaluation of the bodily injury portion pending the treating provider notes.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
